senderStrategy: Personal founder first; WARC is the product/proof hub; Akros Lab is corporate background.

templates.title: New-clinic opener
templates.body: Hi {{Name}} — I'm {{Sender}} with Akros Lab (WARC). Congrats on {{Clinic}} opening in {{OpeningMonthYear}}. We help clinics map patient WhatsApp enquiries into a clear booking path (not patient-acquisition ads). If WhatsApp is a channel you already use for patients and this is useful, OK if I send three short lines — or would email be better?

templates.title: Hand-off question
templates.body: Hi {{Name}}, I'm {{Sender}} at Akros Lab (product: WARC). {{Clinic}} opened {{OpeningMonthYear}} per {{Source}}. If you already take patient messages on WhatsApp, do you have a set hand-off to a booking link, or is every reply still fully manual? I can share how we set that up — only if useful.

templates.title: WhatsApp-use question — start here
templates.body: {{Name}}, I'm {{Sender}} with Akros Lab (WARC). Saw {{Clinic}} open {{OpeningMonthYear}}. WARC is a WhatsApp receptionist for clinics that already use WhatsApp for patients — mapping enquiries to a booking link, not acquiring patients. Do you use WhatsApp for patient enquiries today? If yes and useful, I can send a one-pager when you ask.

templates.title: Spanish inbound / opt-in reply
templates.body: Hola {{Name}}, soy {{Sender}} de Akros Lab (WARC). Gracias por {{RequestContext}}. WARC ayuda a clínicas a convertir consultas de WhatsApp que ya reciben en una vía clara de reserva (no es captación de pacientes). ¿Te envío tres líneas o prefieres una llamada de 30 minutos?

templates.title: UK corporate walkthrough email
templates.body:
Hi {{Name}},

I'm {{Sender}} at Akros Lab (WARC). Congrats on {{Clinic}} opening in {{OpeningMonthYear}} ({{Source}}). WARC is a WhatsApp receptionist that helps answer clinic enquiries and send your booking link — it is not a patient-acquisition service.

If useful, I can show a free 30-minute walkthrough on a sample enquiry on a demo flow (nothing to install to see it). To opt out of further email from me, reply stop.

{{Sender}} · Akros Lab · {{phone}} · warc.akroslab.com

templates.title: Gentle follow-up · days 4–5
templates.body: Hi {{Name}} — {{Sender}} again from Akros Lab (WARC). Happy to close the loop: want the three lines, or shall I leave it? Reply stop if you prefer no further messages.

templates.title: Close the loop · days 12–14
templates.body: Last note from me — {{Sender}} at Akros Lab (WARC). Walkthrough is at warc.akroslab.com if useful; otherwise I'll stop. Reply stop to opt out.

templates.title: Walkthrough reply after engagement
templates.body: Thanks {{Name}} — {{Sender}} at Akros Lab (WARC). I can do a free 30-minute walkthrough on a sample enquiry (nothing to install to see it). Prefer a call or email? Reply stop anytime to opt out.

note: Public message bodies only. No internal_notes or workflow_instruction are included. Channel eligibility remains locked by default in the UI. Follow-ups require the original channel gate to remain valid and no opt-out.
